themes.evidence: Intel invents at the boundaries of technology to make amazing experiences possible for business and society, and for every person on Earth.
Leading on policy, diversity, inclusion, education and sustainability, we create value for our stockholders, customers, and society.

We are investing $300 million in our Diversity in Technology Initiative to achieve full representation of women and under-represented minorities at Intel by 2020, through funding, training, hiring, and retention.

linguistic_shift: The page emphasizes technology innovation, societal impact, and diversity initiatives more prominently than before.
